incident-bot: PagerDuty incident fired: service=runtime-tokenizer threshold=error_rate: 6m spike > 3.0x
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page triggered for rotation 'oncall-sre' - incident #INC-20278
sara: Acked. i'm on it. seeing a single noisy metric in the runtime-telemetry stream.
mike: On phone but monitoring, can you paste the alert graph?
sara: https://telemetry.internal/graphs/abc123 snapshot -> small 30s spike repeating. looks like noisy counters from a single host (gpu-12).
alan: tagging infra: possible exporter flapping after recent rollout. @tori did we push any changes to runtime exporters?
tori: Not on my end. I did a config push to the autoscaler yesterday but nothing touching exporters.
oncall-runner: Handing off to mike (acknowledged) :wave: mike is primary for next 20m.
mike: taking lead. checking pods on gpu-12.
# logs pasted
```
2026-03-14T15:20:01Z runtime[prod]: kv-cache-miss=0.0001 tokens=123
2026-03-14T15:20:02Z exporter[host=gpu-12]: export_errors=12
2026-03-14T15:20:03Z exporter[host=gpu-12]: export_errors=0
```
sara: looks like very short lived error bursts on exporter for host gpu-12, metric spikes cause PD noise.
mike: i can see a restart on exporter process around 15:20:02 on gpu-12, likely a transient crash loop. i've SSH'd in.
alan: any customer impact? graphs for latency/cpu?
sara: customer-facing latency and errors are within SLOs, error-rate bump is internal telemetry only. no 5xx from API. Checked top endpoints, all green.
ton: (infra) i can taint gpu-12 for testing, want to drain and repro?
mike: going to cordon gpu-12 and restart exporter systemd unit.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty NOTE: incident INC-20278 escalated to secondary (mike)
mike: restarted exporter, watching for recurrence.\\n15:20:55 exporter restart succeeded.
sara: nice. any repeats?
mike: no additional spikes in the last 30s.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert resolved automatically (same rule) — it was a transient spike and resolved: resolving incident INC-20278
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-20278 automatically resolved by monitoring.
alan: ok great — no customer impact. recommend we add an exporter retry/backoff guard to avoid metric spikes turning into PD pages.
sara: agree. action items:
- add exponential backoff + jitter to exporter retries (owner: infra/alex?)
- add a suppression rule: if spike originates from a single host for <60s, don't page immediately (oncall: product review for threshold)
- follow up with oncall rotation to confirm if cordon was appropriate
mike: noted. I'll add a short postmortem comment in the incident ticket, marking root cause as transient exporter crash on gpu-12, mitigated by restarting unit.
ton: infra ticket created: INF-4591 with preliminary remediation notes.
sara: closing thread, marking as autoresolved-no-customer-impact. :white_check_mark:
mike: thanks all :thumbsup:
